acceptance: config exposes resolve_user_documents_root() returning an absolute existing directory that is independent of config.APP_ROOT.
The resolver returns the home documents folder when it exists on Windows, macOS, and POSIX.
On POSIX the resolver prefers an existing XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR over the home documents folder.
The resolver returns the home directory when no candidate documents folder exists.
The new-project dialog opens at the active project parent folder when a project is open, and at the resolved documents root otherwise.
The open-project dialog opens at the active project root when a project is open, and at the resolved documents root otherwise.
config.APP_ROOT is no longer used as a file-dialog default directory anywhere in home_ui_controller.
assumptions: Modern Windows keeps the on-disk folder name Documents and localizes only its display name, so a plain ~/Documents probe is correct without Qt or ctypes.
config.py must stay free of PySide6 because it is imported by every headless test, so QStandardPaths is not used.

This worktree branch does not contain config.APP_USER_DATA_ROOT from the sibling run, so the change must not depend on it; projects are operator content and belong under documents rather than an application data root anyway.

alignment.source: User chat: project open/create dialogs default to config.APP_ROOT, which is the read-only install directory for a frozen build; sibling run fix-2026-07-25T151844Z-85bc2369 left this out of scope. Scope confirmed by user: documents/home only, no settings schema change.
alignment.understanding: Add a pure-stdlib resolver config.resolve_user_documents_root() that returns the per-user documents directory for the running platform, falling back to the home directory when no documents folder exists. Windows and macOS use ~/Documents; Linux and other POSIX prefer XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR when set and existing, then ~/Documents. The resolver always returns an existing directory so QFileDialog cannot silently fall back to the process working directory. home_ui_controller then uses that resolver instead of config.APP_ROOT for both project dialog defaults: the new-project dialog starts at the active project parent folder when a project is open and at the resolved documents root otherwise; the open-project dialog starts at the active project root when a project is open and at the resolved documents root otherwise.

intent.statement: Project open/create QFileDialog calls default to the application install root (config.APP_ROOT), which for a frozen build installed into a non-writable location opens the project browser inside the read-only install directory; default instead to a resolved per-user documents directory (falling back to the home directory) when no project is open.

examples: Linux with XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR=/home/u/docs existing -> /home/u/docs; the same variable set on Windows is ignored and ~\Documents wins.
No documents folder exists on any platform -> the home directory is returned so QFileDialog never falls back to the process working directory.
spec_items.statement: config.resolve_user_documents_root() returns the first existing candidate among an XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR override (POSIX only, non-macOS), the home Documents folder, and the home directory, using only the standard library.

examples: Project /data/books/Book5 open -> new-project dialog starts at /data/books, open-project dialog at /data/books/Book5.
No project open, application installed at C:\Program Files\AudioMancer -> both dialogs start at the resolved documents root, never the install root.
spec_items.statement: The Home new-project dialog starts at the active project parent folder and the open-project dialog at the active project root when a project is open; both start at config.resolve_user_documents_root() otherwise, and neither uses config.APP_ROOT.
